summary: All six plan phases completed. Reconciled index.schema.json into the single schema authority (task_types allowed, languages removed, exclusion rationale recorded in a $comment). Added advisory Rules T (schema conformance) and U (EXTENSION.md length) to check-extension-docs.sh behind a new sibling SCHEMA_CONFORMANCE_GATE_MODE (default advisory), with a fixture test (9/9 assertions pass, including the SCHEMA_CONFORMANCE_GATE_MODE=hard severity-wiring case). Corrected both competing prose examples (extension-slim-standard.md and agent-system/extensions/README.md) to the reconciled shape with authority pointers. Brought Tier-1 always-load from 996 lines/6 entries to 334 lines/3 entries (target <=500), matching the plan's predicted 334L exactly, by demoting context-discovery.md, jq-escaping-workarounds.md, and project-overview.md off always:true and giving each a real agents/commands hook; project-overview.md's @-import in merge-sources/claudemd.md was left untouched, removing the duplicate load path without losing the single remaining one. Created four follow-on tasks (990 index_entries_schema_migration, 991 meta_catchall_decomposition, 992 extension_md_slim_down, 993 promote_schema_gates_to_hard) via the mutex-guarded state-write.sh, with 993 depending on [987, 990, 992]. Final verify-deploy.sh run: PASS, 15/15 checks, 0 failures.
decisions_made: Introduced sibling SCHEMA_CONFORMANCE_GATE_MODE (default advisory) rather than reusing INDEX_TRUTH_GATE_MODE (which already defaults hard and whose Rules R/S depend on staying hard), per the plan's own correction to the research recommendation

Corrected extension-slim-standard.md's example path prefix from context/project/{ext}/... to the canonical project/{ext}/... form (matching extensions/README.md's own canonical-path rule) -- a small scope expansion within the plan's 'file_scope is advisory' allowance, needed so the corrected example did not carry a second, silent inconsistency

Fixed index.schema.json's own line_count entry in core/index-entries.json (127->128) as a direct side effect of the Phase 1 schema edit growing the file by one line, avoiding a self-inflicted fresh Rule R drift

Reconciled the Phase 2 Scope Hypothesis's predicted Rule T count (14 of 19) against the actual observed count (17 of 19): the 14-count only tallied load_when.languages violations, omitting the independent load_when.skills violation that flags 3 more extensions (core, literature, memory) with zero languages usage. Recorded as 14+3=17 in the plan and carried into follow-on task 990's description so its scope is accurate

Fixture test's check-extension-docs.sh resolution deliberately prefers the source-store sibling copy over the deployed .claude/scripts/ copy (inverting the deploy-first pattern other tests in this directory use), since this suite validates logic landing in the source store during the same task's earlier phase, before any redeploy
dead_ends: Initial fixture-test candidate-order (deploy-tree-first, matching test-phase-heading-patterns.sh's LIB_CANDIDATES pattern) silently tested the stale, not-yet-redeployed .claude/scripts/check-extension-docs.sh copy and produced 6 false-negative assertion failures before the resolution order was inverted to source-store-first
